screen_model: KBM-7 near-haploid human CML cells with inducible Cas9
library_design: Custom pooled lentiviral library with 73,151 sgRNAs targeting 7,114 genes plus 100 non-targeting controls; normally 10 guides per gene
treatment_contrast: Etoposide-treated versus untreated final populations; dose and exposure duration not reported; resistance enrichment
screen_replication: Not reported; one treated and one untreated pooled KBM-7 population are described
analysis_method: Per-guide differential abundance followed by a one-sided Kolmogorov-Smirnov comparison against non-targeting guides and multiple-test correction
quantitative_asset_locator: Supplementary Table 2 contains gene-level corrected p-values and percentages of scoring sgRNAs, not guide-by-sample counts
rights_basis: PMC provides an author manuscript for reading and citation; no affirmative open redistribution license was found for the Science supplement
validation_source_locator: Figure 2F-G: individual-guide protein and etoposide-response follow-up was performed in HL60 rather than the selected KBM-7 model
curator: Independent Codex literature reviewer; per-study outcome mapping withheld
notes: CDK6 and TOP2A remain V1 because the within-study follow-up used a different cell model; no same-model rescue was reported.

screen_model: HCC364 human BRAF-V600E lung cancer cells expressing Cas9
library_design: GeCKO v2 genome-wide knockout library with approximately 120,000 sgRNAs and approximately six guides per gene
treatment_contrast: 24 nM trametinib with harvest at days 14 and 21; drug-selected abundance compared with day-0 baseline; resistance enrichment
screen_replication: Two independent infection replicates with approximately 500 selected cells per sgRNA
analysis_method: Average sgRNA log2 fold-change followed by STARS gene ranking
quantitative_asset_locator: Supplementary File 1 sheets HCC364 + Tram LFC and HCC364 + Tram STARS contain sgRNA and gene author-derived values, not sample-level counts
rights_basis: Article and Supplementary File 1 are available under CC BY 4.0; no selected-screen raw-read or raw-count asset was located
validation_source_locator: Figure 1D supports KEAP1 in matched HCC364 trametinib follow-up; Figures 2 and 5-6 provide contextual or mechanistic evidence that does not independently validate NFE2L2 for this screen
curator: Independent Codex literature reviewer; per-study outcome mapping withheld
notes: KEAP1 is V2 without a same-model same-contrast genetic rescue; NFE2L2 is retained separately as nonqualifying mechanistic evidence.

screen_model: PC-9 human EGFR-mutant lung cancer cells
library_design: Custom TUSON tumor-suppressor CRISPR library with approximately 500 genes, 10 guides per gene and 1,000 negative controls; approximately 6,000 guides total
treatment_contrast: After editing, PC-9 cells were split to 30 nM gefitinib versus matched DMSO for approximately 17 days; resistance enrichment
screen_replication: The pooled screen was performed in three replicate arms
quantitative_asset_locator: Supplementary Table S1 contains gene-level ranks, fold changes, p-values and FDR values, not guide-by-sample counts
rights_basis: Article and supplement are CC BY-NC 4.0; no separate rights basis was located for an underlying raw-data asset
validation_source_locator: Figures 2B-D and 3A-B: independent CRISPR perturbations in PC-9 with matched gefitinib response and target-loss assessment; no rescue
curator: Independent Codex literature reviewer; per-study outcome mapping withheld
notes: CIC and PBRM1 are V2 in the selected model and treatment direction; no same-model genetic rescue establishes V3.

screen_model: HeLa human cervical cancer cells with stable Cas9
library_design: TKOv1 genome-wide CRISPR knockout library with 91,320 sgRNAs targeting 17,232 genes; at least 200 cells per sgRNA maintained
treatment_contrast: 2 uM olaparib from day 6 to day 15 with a matched untreated endpoint; sensitization depletion
screen_replication: Three technical screen replicates from one infected pool
analysis_method: DrugZ gene-level scoring across HeLa, RPE1 and SUM149PT
quantitative_asset_locator: Supplementary Table 1 contains gene-level DrugZ results for three cell models, not sample-level counts
rights_basis: No affirmative open data license was verified for the source workbook; ORCS licensing does not transfer to publisher supplements
validation_source_locator: Figure 2J and Extended Data Figure 4: RNASEH2A-null HeLa olaparib sensitivity is rescued by wild-type but not inactive RNASEH2A; RNASEH2B lacks equally explicit matched rescue
curator: Independent Codex literature reviewer; per-study outcome mapping withheld
notes: RNASEH2A is V3 through same-model genetic complementation; RNASEH2B remains nonqualifying pending human adjudication of exact model and contrast linkage.
